narrative_goal: Show that interest rates fell sharply from 1991 to 2016, with the Bank of England base rate dropping from about 10.2% to 0.4% and mortgage rates from about 9.5% to 2.2%, framing this decline as a reason houses are expensive.
intent_en: Compare the Bank of England base rate and the example five-year fixed mortgage rate over the period from 1991 to 2016 to determine how each changed.
